nodes.label: MemSlides: Hierarchical Memory for Personalized Slide Generation
nodes.rationale: Framework separating long-term memory (user profile + tool memory) from working memory for multi-turn localized slide revision; enables persistent personalization across jobs while preserving session-specific constraints.

nodes.label: User Profile Memory
nodes.rationale: Long-term memory storing intent-conditioned user preferences organized by presentation dimensions (theme, content, visual, layout, template, general); routed into working memory at job start and consolidated at job end.

nodes.label: Tool Memory for Reliable Editing
nodes.rationale: Execution-side memory organized at round-scope (task experience) and operation-scope (tool-chain experience) granularities; supports reliable multi-turn modification by recording reasoning-tool-observation chains.

nodes.label: Localized Modify Execution
nodes.rationale: Plan-Act-Guard pipeline for multi-turn slide editing; projects revision requests onto smallest affected slide region, applies minimal effective edits, and verifies coverage before finalizing updates.

nodes.label: Multi-Persona Multi-Intent Profile Bank
nodes.rationale: Controlled testbed with 10 occupation-style personas × 3 role-intent buckets = 30 profile entries; covers diverse demographics, occupations, and presentation contexts for personalization evaluation.

nodes.label: Diagnostic Matched-Pair Modify Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Paired agent executions with fixed source deck, model, persona, and request; compares tool-memory injection to measure closed-loop completion, verification, and edit efficiency.

nodes.label: Working Memory for Session State
nodes.rationale: Session-scoped state layer maintaining active temporary preferences, carryover instructions, edit-state records, and tool-memory signals; enables multi-turn revision within single authoring job.

nodes.label: Persona-Alignment Judgment Metrics
nodes.rationale: Four 0-10 dimensions: Content (selection/emphasis), Structure (organization/layout), Visual (density/hierarchy), Specificity (persona distinctiveness); evaluated blind without prompt or system identity.

nodes.label: Template-Guided Generation
nodes.rationale: Uses task-time design constraints from templates to guide slide generation while persona-conditioned generation adapts content and emphasis.

nodes.label: Feature-Level Patch Record
nodes.rationale: Summarizes prior implementation change: affected files, relevant symbols, behavior before/after, constraints to preserve, revision reason, and bounded code evidence.
